title: RTS prototype
author: asgonn
selftext: I'm using Google Anti-Gravity to test its capabilities and taking the opportunity to study software architectures.

comments.body: how did you generate the sprites?

replies.author: asgonn
replies.body: Sprite characters from the internet. Background generated in ChatGPT.

comments.author: Vast-Pair-1468
comments.body: Reminds me a bit of WoW arena.

comments.author: SovereignLG
comments.body: Have you mainly been using Google Gemini for the coding of game logic or a different model on Antigravity?

replies.author: SovereignLG
replies.body:
If you haven't yet, I'd recommend you try using GPT 5.4 as well if you have a ChatGPT subscription or Claude (coming from someone who started vibe coding via Gemini). Gemini 3.1 Pro has been seen by the wider AI community as being great for UI design but falling behind Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT 5.4. 

But if it's been working well for you, no problem! Just thoughts and possibly recommendations. Even comparing what different models would do could be insightful. Personally, since using Codex 5.3, I haven't gone back.

replies.author: asgonn
replies.body: In fact, I programmed most of this project myself, including enemy tracking systems, combat, teams, etc. I used Gemini to create the UI/UIX, sprite handler, visual functions, and general design.

replies.author: SovereignLG
replies.body: That's even better! Appreciate the context. Good job with what you've done so far!

comments.body: Cool stuff. Are you building in js for the browser? Or using an engine that ports to web? Just curious what stack you're using with antigravity
